result.summary: The layout is largely coherent, but several elements are clipped at the right viewport edge and card styling is inconsistent. Found 6 issues, mainly layout/styling truncation problems in the horizontal carousels.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card (Trattoria Piccol…) is hard-clipped by the right edge: both its image and the title/delivery text are cut mid-character with no ellipsis or fade, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/peek offset to the carousel so partially visible cards are intentionally revealed, truncate titles with an ellipsis, and apply a gradient fade or snap-scroll to signal scrollability.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru card uses a white circular background with dark outline, while the pizza card below uses a dark/transparent circle with white outline, so the same control looks different per card.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button to a single treatment (e.g. semi-transparent white scrim with dark icon) across all cards, regardless of image brightness.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while the other two cards in the same row use dark backgrounds, breaking visual rhythm in the row.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image backgrounds (consistent placeholder/backdrop color or overlay) so cards in the same row read as a set.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off after 'Healthy' with a sliver of the next chip visible at the very edge, which reads as an overflow bug instead of a scrollable filter list.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding and a fade/edge indicator to the chip scroller so the next chip is partially and deliberately visible.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is truncated by the bottom tab bar with its name, rating and delivery info hidden, and there is no visible spacing between content and the fixed nav.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height (plus safe area) so cards are never obscured and scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with red dot, heart favorite buttons, search icon) have no visible text labels; if accessible names are also missing, screen reader users get no context.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessibility labels such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' and 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites', and ensure touch targets are at least 44x44.
